questions.question: How many PTO days do full-time employees get per year?
questions.reference: 22 days per year under the current (2026) handbook. The 18-day figure is from the archived 2024 policy.
evidence: accrue 22 days of paid time off

questions.question: How many unused PTO days can be carried over, and when do they expire?
questions.reference: Up to 6 unused days can be carried over; they expire on March 31.
evidence: Up to 6 unused PTO days may be carried over

questions.question: How far in advance do I need to request more than 5 consecutive days off?
questions.reference: At least 3 weeks in advance, through the PeopleHub portal.

questions.question: How many paid holidays does the company observe?
questions.reference: 11 paid holidays per year, plus a company-wide shutdown from December 24 to January 1.

questions.question: What are the core hours remote employees must be reachable?
questions.reference: 10:00 to 15:00 in their local time zone.

questions.question: How much is the home office stipend?
questions.reference: $600, paid once, plus $40 per month for internet. ($400 was the old 2024 amount.)

questions.question: What is the daily limit for meals during business travel?
questions.reference: Up to $75 per day.

questions.question: When do I need a receipt for an expense?
questions.reference: For any single expense above $250, which also requires manager approval.

questions.question: How much parental leave do secondary caregivers get?
questions.reference: 8 weeks of fully paid leave.

questions.question: Does unused learning budget roll over to the next year?
questions.reference: No. The $1,500 annual learning budget does not roll over.
evidence: Unused learning budget does not roll over

questions.question: How much memory do laptops for new engineers have?
questions.reference: 64 GB (other new employees get 32 GB).

questions.question: Are contractors eligible for paid time off?
questions.reference: No, contractors are not eligible for PTO.
evidence: Contractors are not eligible for PTO

questions.question: Who is the project lead for Project Falcon?
questions.reference: Dana Ortiz.
evidence: The project lead is Dana Ortiz

questions.question: Who leads Project Osprey?
questions.reference: Marcus Bell.
evidence: The project lead is Marcus Bell

questions.question: What is Project Falcon's total budget, and how much has been spent so far?
questions.reference: Total budget $2,400,000; $1,575,000 spent to date.

questions.question: How much of Project Osprey's software budget has been spent?
questions.reference: $1,240,000 of the $1,600,000 software budget.

questions.question: What is the testing budget for Project Falcon?
questions.reference: $350,000, of which $95,000 has been spent.

questions.question: Why is Project Falcon's status Amber?
questions.reference: The vision subsystem is two weeks behind schedule because the camera supplier (Lumetrix) is delayed.
evidence: two weeks behind schedule because of a delayed camera supplier

questions.question: When is the Falcon pilot deployment at the Reno warehouse?
questions.reference: February 9, 2027.

questions.question: What is the top risk for Project Osprey?
questions.reference: FAA waiver approval for beyond-visual-line-of-sight flights.

questions.question: Who is the executive sponsor of Project Falcon?
questions.reference: Priya Raman.

questions.question: What should I do for incident SEC-610?
questions.reference: Rotate the exposed credentials immediately, then page the on-call security engineer via #sec-oncall. It is always severity P1.

questions.question: What does ERR_VPN_0x2F mean and how do I fix it?
questions.reference: The certificate has expired. Run halcyon-vpn renew-cert and reconnect.

questions.question: What causes ERR_VPN_0x44?
questions.reference: The account is locked after 5 failed attempts; contact the ServiceDesk to unlock it.

questions.question: What is the price of SKU HX-4471?
questions.reference: $149.00 (Servo Actuator S2).

questions.question: What product is SKU HX-7781 and which warehouse stocks it?
questions.reference: LiDAR Module L4, stocked in the Reno warehouse.

questions.question: What issue did Acme Logistics report in ticket T-20931?
questions.reference: The HR-9 arm stops mid-pick with error E-77; the ticket is escalated.

questions.question: How do I report a phishing email (SEC-417)?
questions.reference: Don't click links; forward the email as an attachment to phish@halcyon-robotics.example and delete it. Security responds within 4 business hours.
evidence: Forward the email as an attachment

questions.question: What warranty comes with Halcyon robotic arms?
questions.reference: A 2-year limited warranty covering parts and labor; extended warranties of up to 5 years can be purchased.

questions.question: What is the restocking fee for opened items?
How often should gripper pads be replaced?
questions.reference: Every 50,000 cycles or every 6 months, whichever comes first.

questions.question: Who approved the Osprey budget increase, and what is Osprey's total budget after the increase?
questions.reference: Priya Raman approved a $180,000 increase, bringing the total to $2,330,000 ($2,150,000 + $180,000).
evidence: approved a $180,000 budget increase for Project Osprey

questions.question: Who is the on-site lead for the Falcon pilot, and when does the pilot start?
questions.reference: Tomas Herrera; the Reno pilot is scheduled for February 9, 2027.
evidence: on-site lead will be Tomas Herrera

questions.question: How many lost laptops were reported in Q3, and what is the procedure for a lost device?
questions.reference: One lost laptop (SEC-502). Procedure: report within 24 hours via a ticket in the HW-LOSS queue; IT remotely wipes the device.
evidence: IT will remotely wipe the device

questions.question: Which project has the larger total budget, Falcon or Osprey, and by how much (according to the status reports)?
questions.reference: Falcon: $2,400,000 vs Osprey's $2,150,000, so Falcon's is $250,000 larger.

questions.question: Is the password rotation period changing?
questions.reference: No. The Q3 security review decided it will remain 180 days.
